name: Yumeochi no Incubus
original_name: 夢堕ちのインキュバス
source:
Pearl, a wizardess living on her own in a grand estate, has been plagued by continuous nightmares. After her familiar, Onyx, suggests consulting someone well-versed in the art of dreaming, Pearl's life starts undergoing major changes.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5700]Freem![/url]]
translation:
珀尔是一位独自住在一座大庄园里的女巫师，她一直被噩梦所困扰。在她的熟人玛瑙建议向精通做梦艺术的人咨询后，珀尔的生活开始发生重大变化。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5700]Freem![/url]]
